+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Provide one pinned CJK fallback in a private CI job, then revalidate it.
+
+Browser/apt setup remains the existing workflow owner's responsibility. This
+helper never installs system packages, changes product CSS, or writes shared
+font directories. --verify performs no download or environment-file mutation.
+"""
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import urllib.request
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+if sys.flags.optimize:
+    raise RuntimeError("Optimized Python cannot run CJK dependency verification")
+
+REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+PIN_PATH = REPO / ".github/fonts/noto-cjk/pin.json"
+PROBE = "sans-serif:lang=zh-cn"
+FORMAT = "%{file}\n%{family[0]}\n%{postscriptname}\n%{charset}\n"
+
+
+def sha256(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def git_blob_sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def regular_bytes(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected a regular, non-symlink file: {path}")
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def load_pin():
+    raw = regular_bytes(PIN_PATH)
+    pin = json.loads(raw)
+    assert pin["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-pin.v1"
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", pin["commit"])
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", pin["sha256"])
+    assert 0 < pin["bytes"] <= 32 * 1024 * 1024
+    assert pin["fileName"] == Path(pin["fileName"]).name
+    assert pin["url"] == (
+        f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{pin['repository']}/{pin['commit']}/{pin['path']}"
+    )
+    license_bytes = regular_bytes(REPO / pin["license"]["path"])
+    assert len(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["bytes"]
+    assert git_blob_sha(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["gitBlobSha"]
+    return pin, raw, license_bytes
+
+
+def validate_font(data, pin):
+    assert len(data) == pin["bytes"], "Pinned font byte length differs"
+    assert sha256(data) == pin["sha256"], "Pinned font SHA-256 differs"
+    assert git_blob_sha(data) == pin["gitBlobSha"], "Pinned upstream Git blob differs"
+
+
+def download_font(pin):
+    request = urllib.request.Request(pin["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "Terminal-CI-font-dependency"})
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
+        data = response.read(pin["bytes"] + 1)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    return data
+
+
+def configuration(root, base, pin):
+    family = pin["family"]
+    document = ET.Element("fontconfig")
+    # Fontconfig writes its first accessible cache. Keep this before the base
+    # include so simultaneous ubuntu0 slots cannot share this job's cache.
+    ET.SubElement(document, "cachedir").text = str(root / "cache")
+    ET.SubElement(document, "include", {"ignore_missing": "no"}).text = str(base)
+    ET.SubElement(document, "dir").text = str(root / "fonts")
+    # A runner may already have another version of this family. Keep its files
+    # untouched, but select only our pinned face within this private config.
+    selection = ET.SubElement(document, "selectfont")
+    rejected = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "rejectfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(rejected, "patelt", {"name": "family"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = family
+    accepted = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "acceptfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(accepted, "patelt", {"name": "file"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = str(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    # Keep the base's Latin environment; prefer the pinned native fallback only
+    # for Chinese generic sans requests. This does not inject a page stylesheet.
+    match = ET.SubElement(document, "match", {"target": "pattern"})
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "lang", "compare": "contains"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "zh"
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "family", "compare": "eq"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "sans-serif"
+    edit = ET.SubElement(match, "edit", {"name": "family", "mode": "prepend_first", "binding": "strong"})
+    ET.SubElement(edit, "string").text = family
+    return (b'<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">\n'
+            + ET.tostring(document, encoding="utf-8") + b"\n")
+
+
+def charset_ranges(value):
+    ranges = []
+    for token in value.split():
+        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+(?:-[0-9a-fA-F]+)?", token):
+            raise ValueError("Unrecognized Fontconfig charset")
+        parts = token.split("-")
+        low, high = int(parts[0], 16), int(parts[-1], 16)
+        assert 0 <= low <= high <= 0x10FFFF
+        ranges.append([low, high])
+    assert ranges, "Fontconfig returned no glyph coverage"
+    return ranges
+
+
+def run_fontconfig(args, env):
+    result = subprocess.run(args, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+def face(args, env, font_path, pin):
+    rows = run_fontconfig(args, env).splitlines()
+    assert len(rows) == 4, "Incomplete Fontconfig face record"
+    assert Path(rows[0]).resolve() == font_path, "Fontconfig selected an unpinned fallback"
+    assert rows[1] == pin["family"], "Font family differs"
+    assert rows[2] == pin["postScriptName"], "PostScript face differs"
+    ranges = charset_ranges(rows[3])
+    missing = [f"U+{ord(char):04X}" for char in sorted(set(pin["requiredText"]))
+               if not any(low <= ord(char) <= high for low, high in ranges)]
+    assert not missing, "Missing required Chinese glyphs: " + ", ".join(missing)
+    return {"file": str(font_path), "family": rows[1], "postScriptName": rows[2],
+            "charsetRanges": ranges, "requiredText": pin["requiredText"]}
+
+
+def snapshot(root, base, env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes):
+    root, base = Path(root), Path(base)
+    font_path = root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"]
+    data = regular_bytes(font_path)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_bytes = regular_bytes(config_path)
+    cache = root / "cache"
+    assert cache.is_dir() and not cache.is_symlink() and os.access(cache, os.W_OK), "Private font cache is unavailable"
+    assert config_bytes == configuration(root, base, pin), "Job font configuration changed"
+    assert env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") == str(config_path), "Job font configuration is not active"
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/OFL.txt") == license_bytes
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").decode("utf-8") == pin["copyright"] + "\n"
+    inspected = face(["fc-query", "--format", FORMAT, str(font_path)], env, font_path, pin)
+    resolved = face(["fc-match", "--format", FORMAT, PROBE], env, font_path, pin)
+    assert inspected == resolved, "Resolved CJK face differs from the inspected pinned face"
+    return {"pinSha256": sha256(pin_bytes),
+            "font": {"file": str(font_path), "sha256": sha256(data), "bytes": len(data),
+                     "gitBlobSha": pin["gitBlobSha"], "licenseSha256": sha256(license_bytes)},
+            "fontconfig": {"file": str(config_path), "sha256": sha256(config_bytes),
+                           "baseFile": str(base), "baseSha256": sha256(regular_bytes(base)),
+                           "cacheDirectory": str(root / "cache")},
+            "resolvedFor": PROBE, "resolvedFace": resolved}
+
+
+def verify(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    receipt_path = Path(env["TERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT"])
+    receipt_bytes = regular_bytes(receipt_path)
+    receipt = json.loads(receipt_bytes)
+    assert receipt["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-setup.v1"
+    assert receipt["workflow"] == {
+        "repository": env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"), "run": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
+        "attempt": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"), "job": env.get("GITHUB_JOB")}, "Font receipt belongs to another job"
+    root = receipt_path.parent.resolve()
+    assert root.is_relative_to(Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve()), "Font receipt is outside this runner's temp root"
+    assert receipt_path.name == "receipt.json"
+    observed = snapshot(root, receipt["snapshot"]["fontconfig"]["baseFile"], env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes)
+    assert observed == receipt["snapshot"], "Prepared font environment changed"
+    return {"schema": "terminal.cjk-font-runtime.v1", "receiptSha256": sha256(receipt_bytes),
+            "workflow": receipt["workflow"], **observed}
+
+
+def install(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    temp_root = Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    env_file = Path(env["GITHUB_ENV"])
+    assert env_file.is_absolute() and not env_file.is_symlink() and env_file.is_file()
+    assert not any(char in str(temp_root) + str(env_file) for char in "\r\n")
+    base = Path(env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") or "/etc/fonts/fonts.conf").resolve(strict=True)
+    regular_bytes(base)
+    for command in ["fc-cache", "fc-query", "fc-match"]:
+        if not shutil.which(command, path=env.get("PATH")):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Required existing Fontconfig command is unavailable: {command}")
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="terminal-cjk-", dir=temp_root)).resolve()
+    (root / "fonts").mkdir(); (root / "cache").mkdir()
+    data = download_font(pin)
+    temporary = root / "font.download"
+    temporary.write_bytes(data)
+    temporary.replace(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    (root / "fonts/OFL.txt").write_bytes(license_bytes)
+    (root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").write_text(pin["copyright"] + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_path.write_bytes(configuration(root, base, pin))
+    scoped = {**env, "FONTCONFIG_FILE": str(config_path)}
+    run_fontconfig(["fc-cache", "--force", str(root / "fonts")], scoped)
+    observed = snapshot(root, base, scoped, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes)
+    receipt = {"schema": "terminal.cjk-font-setup.v1", "preparedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+               "workflow": {"repository": env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"), "run": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
+                            "attempt": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"), "job": env.get("GITHUB_JOB")},
+               "snapshot": observed}
+    receipt_path = root / "receipt.json"
+    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    scoped["TERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT"] = str(receipt_path)
+    verified = verify(scoped)
+    # Export only after bytes, license, config, resolver and coverage all pass.
+    with env_file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
+        output.write(f"FONTCONFIG_FILE={config_path}\nTERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT={receipt_path}\n")
+    return verified
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] not in ("--install", "--verify"):
+        raise SystemExit("Use --install or --verify")
+    try:
+        result = install() if sys.argv[1] == "--install" else verify()
+        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))
+    except Exception as error:
+        print(f"CJK font dependency verification failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        raise SystemExit(1) from error

@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+# PR #1048: original CI active-inbox packet import
+
+The published head `4ffab199156516d94a5a3a2d7e860fa342813eb2` carried a stale active-inbox driver binding. The unchanged strict reader reproduces that failure: recorded driver `856da74c...`, actual driver `8ccd2435...`. This repair imports the already-returned original CI artifact; it does not recapture or rewrite capture identity.
+
+## Exact source and artifact
+
+- Original workflow: https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/actions/runs/43088893028 (attempt 1).
+- Artifact `unit-evidence-43088893028-1`, ID `13890390476`; zip SHA-256 `c9877931c8fc22a7bd87e3bbf9e1e54ee7fa8be0e1586f17ff1109e9fc9fcf56`.
+- Actual producer checkout `0d86ec458ae5589a02257305842f37d5b8584d6c`, tree `01143905d2933d5d4504bb5060033db74f1fd14d`, captured `2026-11-11T19:41:37.944Z`. The immutable GitHub readback confirms parents `568fa505afb068900424fe4db0da67587d46a114` and `4ffab199156516d94a5a3a2d7e860fa342813eb2`.
+- Exact manifest SHA-256 `ccb6a5f19cb6498016ca986555488dc9a988896b5f3e6abcbd18fdab32013b04`. Raw checkout, producer proof and producer manifest are preserved under `original-ci-artifact/`.
+
+## Qualification
+
+The existing `readInboxPacket` rejects the prior selected packet, accepts the staged original artifact, and accepts the installed packet after the eight PNGs are copied and `capture.json` is copied last. All 15 source bindings, all eight full PNG decodes, exact image digests, crop geometry, versions and cleanup receipts pass. The existing `f11_7RecurringBriefsEvidence.test.ts` passes all six tests unchanged. All 13 historical mixed-packet files and the existing explicit scope file remain byte-identical. The prior selected active packet is retained under `historical-active-inbox/`.
+

@@ -0,0 +1,229 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Provide one pinned CJK fallback in a private CI job, then revalidate it.
+
+Browser/apt setup remains the existing workflow owner's responsibility. This
+helper never installs system packages, changes product CSS, or writes shared
+font directories. --verify performs no download or environment-file mutation.
+"""
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import urllib.request
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+if sys.flags.optimize:
+    raise RuntimeError("Optimized Python cannot run CJK dependency verification")
+
+REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+PIN_PATH = REPO / ".github/fonts/noto-cjk/pin.json"
+PROBE = "sans-serif:lang=zh-cn"
+FORMAT = "%{file}\n%{family[0]}\n%{postscriptname}\n%{charset}\n"
+
+
+def sha256(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def git_blob_sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def regular_bytes(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected a regular, non-symlink file: {path}")
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def load_pin():
+    raw = regular_bytes(PIN_PATH)
+    pin = json.loads(raw)
+    assert pin["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-pin.v1"
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", pin["commit"])
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", pin["sha256"])
+    assert 0 < pin["bytes"] <= 32 * 1024 * 1024
+    assert pin["fileName"] == Path(pin["fileName"]).name
+    assert pin["url"] == (
+        f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{pin['repository']}/{pin['commit']}/{pin['path']}"
+    )
+    license_bytes = regular_bytes(REPO / pin["license"]["path"])
+    assert len(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["bytes"]
+    assert git_blob_sha(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["gitBlobSha"]
+    return pin, raw, license_bytes
+
+
+def validate_font(data, pin):
+    assert len(data) == pin["bytes"], "Pinned font byte length differs"
+    assert sha256(data) == pin["sha256"], "Pinned font SHA-256 differs"
+    assert git_blob_sha(data) == pin["gitBlobSha"], "Pinned upstream Git blob differs"
+
+
+def download_font(pin):
+    request = urllib.request.Request(pin["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "Terminal-CI-font-dependency"})
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
+        data = response.read(pin["bytes"] + 1)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    return data
+
+
+def configuration(root, base, pin):
+    family = pin["family"]
+    document = ET.Element("fontconfig")
+    # Fontconfig writes its first accessible cache. Keep this before the base
+    # include so simultaneous ubuntu0 slots cannot share this job's cache.
+    ET.SubElement(document, "cachedir").text = str(root / "cache")
+    ET.SubElement(document, "include", {"ignore_missing": "no"}).text = str(base)
+    ET.SubElement(document, "dir").text = str(root / "fonts")
+    # A runner may already have another version of this family. Keep its files
+    # untouched, but select only our pinned face within this private config.
+    selection = ET.SubElement(document, "selectfont")
+    rejected = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "rejectfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(rejected, "patelt", {"name": "family"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = family
+    accepted = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "acceptfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(accepted, "patelt", {"name": "file"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = str(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    # Keep the base's Latin environment; prefer the pinned native fallback only
+    # for Chinese generic sans requests. This does not inject a page stylesheet.
+    match = ET.SubElement(document, "match", {"target": "pattern"})
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "lang", "compare": "contains"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "zh"
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "family", "compare": "eq"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "sans-serif"
+    edit = ET.SubElement(match, "edit", {"name": "family", "mode": "prepend_first", "binding": "strong"})
+    ET.SubElement(edit, "string").text = family
+    return (b'<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">\n'
+            + ET.tostring(document, encoding="utf-8") + b"\n")
+
+
+def charset_ranges(value):
+    ranges = []
+    for token in value.split():
+        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+(?:-[0-9a-fA-F]+)?", token):
+            raise ValueError("Unrecognized Fontconfig charset")
+        parts = token.split("-")
+        low, high = int(parts[0], 16), int(parts[-1], 16)
+        assert 0 <= low <= high <= 0x10FFFF
+        ranges.append([low, high])
+    assert ranges, "Fontconfig returned no glyph coverage"
+    return ranges
+
+
+def run_fontconfig(args, env):
+    result = subprocess.run(args, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+def face(args, env, font_path, pin):
+    rows = run_fontconfig(args, env).splitlines()
+    assert len(rows) == 4, "Incomplete Fontconfig face record"
+    assert Path(rows[0]).resolve() == font_path, "Fontconfig selected an unpinned fallback"
+    assert rows[1] == pin["family"], "Font family differs"
+    assert rows[2] == pin["postScriptName"], "PostScript face differs"
+    ranges = charset_ranges(rows[3])
+    missing = [f"U+{ord(char):04X}" for char in sorted(set(pin["requiredText"]))
+               if not any(low <= ord(char) <= high for low, high in ranges)]
+    assert not missing, "Missing required Chinese glyphs: " + ", ".join(missing)
+    return {"file": str(font_path), "family": rows[1], "postScriptName": rows[2],
+            "charsetRanges": ranges, "requiredText": pin["requiredText"]}
+
+
+def snapshot(root, base, env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes):
+    root, base = Path(root), Path(base)
+    font_path = root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"]
+    data = regular_bytes(font_path)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_bytes = regular_bytes(config_path)
+    cache = root / "cache"
+    assert cache.is_dir() and not cache.is_symlink() and os.access(cache, os.W_OK), "Private font cache is unavailable"
+    assert config_bytes == configuration(root, base, pin), "Job font configuration changed"
+    assert env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") == str(config_path), "Job font configuration is not active"
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/OFL.txt") == license_bytes
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").decode("utf-8") == pin["copyright"] + "\n"
+    inspected = face(["fc-query", "--format", FORMAT, str(font_path)], env, font_path, pin)
+    resolved = face(["fc-match", "--format", FORMAT, PROBE], env, font_path, pin)
+    assert inspected == resolved, "Resolved CJK face differs from the inspected pinned face"
+    return {"pinSha256": sha256(pin_bytes),
+            "font": {"file": str(font_path), "sha256": sha256(data), "bytes": len(data),
+                     "gitBlobSha": pin["gitBlobSha"], "licenseSha256": sha256(license_bytes)},
+            "fontconfig": {"file": str(config_path), "sha256": sha256(config_bytes),
+                           "baseFile": str(base), "baseSha256": sha256(regular_bytes(base)),
+                           "cacheDirectory": str(root / "cache")},
+            "resolvedFor": PROBE, "resolvedFace": resolved}
+
+
+def verify(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    receipt_path = Path(env["TERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT"])
+    receipt_bytes = regular_bytes(receipt_path)
+    receipt = json.loads(receipt_bytes)
+    assert receipt["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-setup.v1"
+    assert receipt["workflow"] == {
+        "repository": env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"), "run": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
+        "attempt": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"), "job": env.get("GITHUB_JOB")}, "Font receipt belongs to another job"
+    root = receipt_path.parent.resolve()
+    assert root.is_relative_to(Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve()), "Font receipt is outside this runner's temp root"
+    assert receipt_path.name == "receipt.json"
+    observed = snapshot(root, receipt["snapshot"]["fontconfig"]["baseFile"], env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes)
+    assert observed == receipt["snapshot"], "Prepared font environment changed"
+    return {"schema": "terminal.cjk-font-runtime.v1", "receiptSha256": sha256(receipt_bytes),
+            "workflow": receipt["workflow"], **observed}
+
+
+def install(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    temp_root = Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    env_file = Path(env["GITHUB_ENV"])
+    assert env_file.is_absolute() and not env_file.is_symlink() and env_file.is_file()
+    assert not any(char in str(temp_root) + str(env_file) for char in "\r\n")
+    base = Path(env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") or "/etc/fonts/fonts.conf").resolve(strict=True)
+    regular_bytes(base)
+    for command in ["fc-cache", "fc-query", "fc-match"]:
+        if not shutil.which(command, path=env.get("PATH")):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Required existing Fontconfig command is unavailable: {command}")
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="terminal-cjk-", dir=temp_root)).resolve()
+    (root / "fonts").mkdir(); (root / "cache").mkdir()
+    data = download_font(pin)
+    temporary = root / "font.download"
+    temporary.write_bytes(data)
+    temporary.replace(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    (root / "fonts/OFL.txt").write_bytes(license_bytes)
+    (root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").write_text(pin["copyright"] + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_path.write_bytes(configuration(root, base, pin))
+    scoped = {**env, "FONTCONFIG_FILE": str(config_path)}
+    run_fontconfig(["fc-cache", "--force", str(root / "fonts")], scoped)

The attached original failure excerpt shows an obsolete transitional-cache expectation and a ticker evidence lock still bound to the prior TerminalShell. The actual CI merge checkout was 09495282, with canonical parents 18fabe9d and e368f26. Event metadata and branch-head identities are not substituted for that checkout.
+
+## Drawing owner behavior
+
+The product already resets the previous owner's drawing store in useLayoutEffect and publishes its store ref synchronously. The test now first proves owner A has a ready cache, then requires the transient B/A observation to contain no A cache and remain disabled. It still checks B's own ready placeholder, actual requests, stale A rejection immunity, and current B rejection disabling. All six drawing readiness tests pass. Temporarily restoring only the passive-effect reset makes the selected case fail on hasCache=true; the original TerminalShell bytes were restored exactly. No product behavior was relaxed to satisfy an obsolete expectation.
+

+
+The existing serial Playwright owner now records its actual checkout, before/after sources, previous packet and sibling packet inventories, ten EN/ZH crops across desktop/tablet/mobile and unavailable states, exact report rows, and settled lifecycle. The observer is the already-qualified #1403 implementation with only two nonexistent WatchlistDisplaySettings paths omitted from its source list. The sixteen retained source inputs include the actual shell, spec, helpers, observer, configuration and lockfile. Its 33 receipt tests pass. No layout lock or image has been restamped. A genuine natural CI capture must return before its ten images and EVIDENCE.yml can be imported.
+

The shard contract now classifies opt-in suites by an actual opt-in environment flag; an ordinary ticker recapture is not a feature flag. All 281 affected CI contracts pass, including the existing four opt-in suites and production selection. Changed JS/TS lint and observer syntax checks pass. Full strict TypeScript from e368 remains the accepted unchanged-product check; natural CI will validate this followup.

The next natural run must capture and validate a complete successor under the unchanged producer, explicit records selector and consumers. Historical PL6/VI/Batch3 manifests and memberships remain byte-exact. The committed-lock planner remains unchanged and binding. Complete generated operation families stay under the incumbent Actions artifact owner, with exact qualification and retention metadata required before acceptance; a green job or hash-only record cannot replace missing payloads.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Provide one pinned CJK fallback in a private CI job, then revalidate it.
+
+Browser/apt setup remains the existing workflow owner's responsibility. This
+helper never installs system packages, changes product CSS, or writes shared
+font directories. --verify performs no download or environment-file mutation.
+"""
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import urllib.request
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+if sys.flags.optimize:
+    raise RuntimeError("Optimized Python cannot run CJK dependency verification")
+
+REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+PIN_PATH = REPO / ".github/fonts/noto-cjk/pin.json"
+PROBE = "sans-serif:lang=zh-cn"
+FORMAT = "%{file}\n%{family[0]}\n%{postscriptname}\n%{charset}\n"
+
+
+def sha256(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def git_blob_sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def regular_bytes(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected a regular, non-symlink file: {path}")
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def load_pin():
+    raw = regular_bytes(PIN_PATH)
+    pin = json.loads(raw)
+    assert pin["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-pin.v1"
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", pin["commit"])
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", pin["sha256"])
+    assert 0 < pin["bytes"] <= 32 * 1024 * 1024
+    assert pin["fileName"] == Path(pin["fileName"]).name
+    assert pin["url"] == (
+        f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{pin['repository']}/{pin['commit']}/{pin['path']}"
+    )
+    license_bytes = regular_bytes(REPO / pin["license"]["path"])
+    assert len(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["bytes"]
+    assert git_blob_sha(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["gitBlobSha"]
+    return pin, raw, license_bytes
+
+
+def validate_font(data, pin):
+    assert len(data) == pin["bytes"], "Pinned font byte length differs"
+    assert sha256(data) == pin["sha256"], "Pinned font SHA-256 differs"
+    assert git_blob_sha(data) == pin["gitBlobSha"], "Pinned upstream Git blob differs"
+
+
+def download_font(pin):
+    request = urllib.request.Request(pin["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "Terminal-CI-font-dependency"})
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
+        data = response.read(pin["bytes"] + 1)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    return data
+
+
+def configuration(root, base, pin):
+    family = pin["family"]
+    document = ET.Element("fontconfig")
+    # Fontconfig writes its first accessible cache. Keep this before the base
+    # include so simultaneous ubuntu0 slots cannot share this job's cache.
+    ET.SubElement(document, "cachedir").text = str(root / "cache")
+    ET.SubElement(document, "include", {"ignore_missing": "no"}).text = str(base)
+    ET.SubElement(document, "dir").text = str(root / "fonts")
+    # A runner may already have another version of this family. Keep its files
+    # untouched, but select only our pinned face within this private config.
+    selection = ET.SubElement(document, "selectfont")
+    rejected = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "rejectfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(rejected, "patelt", {"name": "family"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = family
+    accepted = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "acceptfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(accepted, "patelt", {"name": "file"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = str(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    # Keep the base's Latin environment; prefer the pinned native fallback only
+    # for Chinese generic sans requests. This does not inject a page stylesheet.
+    match = ET.SubElement(document, "match", {"target": "pattern"})
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "lang", "compare": "contains"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "zh"
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "family", "compare": "eq"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "sans-serif"
+    edit = ET.SubElement(match, "edit", {"name": "family", "mode": "prepend_first", "binding": "strong"})
+    ET.SubElement(edit, "string").text = family
+    return (b'<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">\n'
+            + ET.tostring(document, encoding="utf-8") + b"\n")
+
+
+def charset_ranges(value):
+    ranges = []
+    for token in value.split():
+        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+(?:-[0-9a-fA-F]+)?", token):
+            raise ValueError("Unrecognized Fontconfig charset")
+        parts = token.split("-")
+        low, high = int(parts[0], 16), int(parts[-1], 16)
+        assert 0 <= low <= high <= 0x10FFFF
+        ranges.append([low, high])
+    assert ranges, "Fontconfig returned no glyph coverage"
+    return ranges
+
+
+def run_fontconfig(args, env):
+    result = subprocess.run(args, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+def face(args, env, font_path, pin):
+    rows = run_fontconfig(args, env).splitlines()
+    assert len(rows) == 4, "Incomplete Fontconfig face record"
+    assert Path(rows[0]).resolve() == font_path, "Fontconfig selected an unpinned fallback"
+    assert rows[1] == pin["family"], "Font family differs"
+    assert rows[2] == pin["postScriptName"], "PostScript face differs"
+    ranges = charset_ranges(rows[3])
+    missing = [f"U+{ord(char):04X}" for char in sorted(set(pin["requiredText"]))
+               if not any(low <= ord(char) <= high for low, high in ranges)]
+    assert not missing, "Missing required Chinese glyphs: " + ", ".join(missing)
+    return {"file": str(font_path), "family": rows[1], "postScriptName": rows[2],
+            "charsetRanges": ranges, "requiredText": pin["requiredText"]}
+
+
+def snapshot(root, base, env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes):
+    root, base = Path(root), Path(base)
+    font_path = root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"]
+    data = regular_bytes(font_path)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_bytes = regular_bytes(config_path)
+    cache = root / "cache"
+    assert cache.is_dir() and not cache.is_symlink() and os.access(cache, os.W_OK), "Private font cache is unavailable"
+    assert config_bytes == configuration(root, base, pin), "Job font configuration changed"
+    assert env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") == str(config_path), "Job font configuration is not active"
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/OFL.txt") == license_bytes
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").decode("utf-8") == pin["copyright"] + "\n"
+    inspected = face(["fc-query", "--format", FORMAT, str(font_path)], env, font_path, pin)
+    resolved = face(["fc-match", "--format", FORMAT, PROBE], env, font_path, pin)
+    assert inspected == resolved, "Resolved CJK face differs from the inspected pinned face"
+    return {"pinSha256": sha256(pin_bytes),
+            "font": {"file": str(font_path), "sha256": sha256(data), "bytes": len(data),
+                     "gitBlobSha": pin["gitBlobSha"], "licenseSha256": sha256(license_bytes)},
+            "fontconfig": {"file": str(config_path), "sha256": sha256(config_bytes),
+                           "baseFile": str(base), "baseSha256": sha256(regular_bytes(base)),
+                           "cacheDirectory": str(root / "cache")},
+            "resolvedFor": PROBE, "resolvedFace": resolved}
+
+
+def verify(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    receipt_path = Path(env["TERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT"])
+    receipt_bytes = regular_bytes(receipt_path)
+    receipt = json.loads(receipt_bytes)
+    assert receipt["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-setup.v1"
+    assert receipt["workflow"] == {
+        "repository": env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"), "run": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
+        "attempt": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"), "job": env.get("GITHUB_JOB")}, "Font receipt belongs to another job"
+    root = receipt_path.parent.resolve()
+    assert root.is_relative_to(Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve()), "Font receipt is outside this runner's temp root"
+    assert receipt_path.name == "receipt.json"
+    observed = snapshot(root, receipt["snapshot"]["fontconfig"]["baseFile"], env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes)
+    assert observed == receipt["snapshot"], "Prepared font environment changed"
+    return {"schema": "terminal.cjk-font-runtime.v1", "receiptSha256": sha256(receipt_bytes),
+            "workflow": receipt["workflow"], **observed}
+
+
+def install(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    temp_root = Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    env_file = Path(env["GITHUB_ENV"])
+    assert env_file.is_absolute() and not env_file.is_symlink() and env_file.is_file()
+    assert not any(char in str(temp_root) + str(env_file) for char in "\r\n")
+    base = Path(env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") or "/etc/fonts/fonts.conf").resolve(strict=True)
+    regular_bytes(base)
+    for command in ["fc-cache", "fc-query", "fc-match"]:
+        if not shutil.which(command, path=env.get("PATH")):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Required existing Fontconfig command is unavailable: {command}")
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="terminal-cjk-", dir=temp_root)).resolve()
+    (root / "fonts").mkdir(); (root / "cache").mkdir()
+    data = download_font(pin)
+    temporary = root / "font.download"
+    temporary.write_bytes(data)
+    temporary.replace(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    (root / "fonts/OFL.txt").write_bytes(license_bytes)
+    (root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").write_text(pin["copyright"] + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_path.write_bytes(configuration(root, base, pin))
+    scoped = {**env, "FONTCONFIG_FILE": str(config_path)}
+    run_fontconfig(["fc-cache", "--force", str(root / "fonts")], scoped)
+    observed = snapshot(root, base, scoped, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes)
+    receipt = {"schema": "terminal.cjk-font-setup.v1", "preparedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+               "workflow": {"repository": env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"), "run": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
+                            "attempt": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"), "job": env.get("GITHUB_JOB")},
+               "snapshot": observed}
+    receipt_path = root / "receipt.json"
+    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    scoped["TERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT"] = str(receipt_path)
+    verified = verify(scoped)
+    # Export only after bytes, license, config, resolver and coverage all pass.
+    with env_file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
+        output.write(f"FONTCONFIG_FILE={config_path}\nTERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT={receipt_path}\n")
+    return verified
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] not in ("--install", "--verify"):
+        raise SystemExit("Use --install or --verify")
+    try:
+        result = install() if sys.argv[1] == "--install" else verify()
+        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))
+    except Exception as error:
+        print(f"CJK font dependency verification failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        raise SystemExit(1) from error

+# Correct the drawing cache contract and obtain a current ticker packet
+
+The previous source candidate e368f26 completed the current-input capture and F11 entry steps. Its unit job 130420100557 in run 42989799627 passed 23,272 tests and failed two. The attached original failure excerpt shows an obsolete transitional-cache expectation and a ticker evidence lock still bound to the prior TerminalShell. The actual CI merge checkout was 09495282, with canonical parents 18fabe9d and e368f26. Event metadata and branch-head identities are not substituted for that checkout.
+
+## Drawing owner behavior
+
+The product already resets the previous owner's drawing store in useLayoutEffect and publishes its store ref synchronously. The test now first proves owner A has a ready cache, then requires the transient B/A observation to contain no A cache and remain disabled. It still checks B's own ready placeholder, actual requests, stale A rejection immunity, and current B rejection disabling. All six drawing readiness tests pass. Temporarily restoring only the passive-effect reset makes the selected case fail on hasCache=true; the original TerminalShell bytes were restored exactly. No product behavior was relaxed to satisfy an obsolete expectation.
+
+## Ticker capture and source binding
+
+The existing serial Playwright owner now records its actual checkout, before/after sources, previous packet and sibling packet inventories, ten EN/ZH crops across desktop/tablet/mobile and unavailable states, exact report rows, and settled lifecycle. The observer is the already-qualified #1403 implementation with only two nonexistent WatchlistDisplaySettings paths omitted from its source list. The sixteen retained source inputs include the actual shell, spec, helpers, observer, configuration and lockfile. Its 33 receipt tests pass. No layout lock or image has been restamped. A genuine natural CI capture must return before its ten images and EVIDENCE.yml can be imported.
+
+The workflow retains the same serial lane, port, one worker, zero retries, job budget and existing artifact uploader. The shard contract now classifies opt-in suites by an actual opt-in environment flag; an ordinary ticker recapture is not a feature flag. All 281 affected CI contracts pass, including the existing four opt-in suites and production selection. Changed JS/TS lint and observer syntax checks pass. Full strict TypeScript from e368 remains the accepted unchanged-product check; natural CI will validate this followup.
+
+Both new e2e/tools files participate in the existing recursive visual source snapshot. Therefore the older e368 PL6/VI operation cannot qualify the new candidate. The next natural run must capture and validate a complete successor under the unchanged producer, explicit records selector and consumers. Historical PL6/VI/Batch3 manifests and memberships remain byte-exact. The committed-lock planner remains unchanged and binding. Complete generated operation families stay under the incumbent Actions artifact owner, with exact qualification and retention metadata required before acceptance; a green job or hash-only record cannot replace missing payloads.
+
+SQL0050, coordinated Macro/provider behavior, ordinary-model target/ACK/persistence acceptance, the historical M2 cleanup EPERM boundary, and native merge/release controls remain open. This source repair neither applies a migration nor enrolls, merges, deploys or claims production acceptance.

--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/scripts/terminal_cjk_font.py
@@ -0,0 +1,229 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Provide one pinned CJK fallback in a private CI job, then revalidate it.
+
+Browser/apt setup remains the existing workflow owner's responsibility. This
+helper never installs system packages, changes product CSS, or writes shared
+font directories. --verify performs no download or environment-file mutation.
+"""
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import urllib.request
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+if sys.flags.optimize:
+    raise RuntimeError("Optimized Python cannot run CJK dependency verification")
+
+REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+PIN_PATH = REPO / ".github/fonts/noto-cjk/pin.json"
+PROBE = "sans-serif:lang=zh-cn"
+FORMAT = "%{file}\n%{family[0]}\n%{postscriptname}\n%{charset}\n"
+
+
+def sha256(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def git_blob_sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def regular_bytes(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected a regular, non-symlink file: {path}")
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def load_pin():
+    raw = regular_bytes(PIN_PATH)
+    pin = json.loads(raw)
+    assert pin["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-pin.v1"
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", pin["commit"])
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", pin["sha256"])
+    assert 0 < pin["bytes"] <= 32 * 1024 * 1024
+    assert pin["fileName"] == Path(pin["fileName"]).name
+    assert pin["url"] == (
+        f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{pin['repository']}/{pin['commit']}/{pin['path']}"
+    )
+    license_bytes = regular_bytes(REPO / pin["license"]["path"])
+    assert len(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["bytes"]
+    assert git_blob_sha(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["gitBlobSha"]
+    return pin, raw, license_bytes
+
+
+def validate_font(data, pin):
+    assert len(data) == pin["bytes"], "Pinned font byte length differs"
+    assert sha256(data) == pin["sha256"], "Pinned font SHA-256 differs"
+    assert git_blob_sha(data) == pin["gitBlobSha"], "Pinned upstream Git blob differs"
+
+
+def download_font(pin):
+    request = urllib.request.Request(pin["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "Terminal-CI-font-dependency"})
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
+        data = response.read(pin["bytes"] + 1)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    return data
+
+
+def configuration(root, base, pin):
+    family = pin["family"]
+    document = ET.Element("fontconfig")
+    # Fontconfig writes its first accessible cache. Keep this before the base
+    # include so simultaneous ubuntu0 slots cannot share this job's cache.
+    ET.SubElement(document, "cachedir").text = str(root / "cache")
+    ET.SubElement(document, "include", {"ignore_missing": "no"}).text = str(base)
+    ET.SubElement(document, "dir").text = str(root / "fonts")
+    # A runner may already have another version of this family. Keep its files
+    # untouched, but select only our pinned face within this private config.
+    selection = ET.SubElement(document, "selectfont")
+    rejected = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "rejectfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(rejected, "patelt", {"name": "family"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = family
+    accepted = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "acceptfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(accepted, "patelt", {"name": "file"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = str(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    # Keep the base's Latin environment; prefer the pinned native fallback only
+    # for Chinese generic sans requests. This does not inject a page stylesheet.
+    match = ET.SubElement(document, "match", {"target": "pattern"})
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "lang", "compare": "contains"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "zh"
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "family", "compare": "eq"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "sans-serif"
+    edit = ET.SubElement(match, "edit", {"name": "family", "mode": "prepend_first", "binding": "strong"})
+    ET.SubElement(edit, "string").text = family
+    return (b'<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">\n'
+            + ET.tostring(document, encoding="utf-8") + b"\n")
+
+
+def charset_ranges(value):
+    ranges = []
+    for token in value.split():
+        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+(?:-[0-9a-fA-F]+)?", token):
+            raise ValueError("Unrecognized Fontconfig charset")
+        parts = token.split("-")
+        low, high = int(parts[0], 16), int(parts[-1], 16)
+        assert 0 <= low <= high <= 0x10FFFF
+        ranges.append([low, high])
+    assert ranges, "Fontconfig returned no glyph coverage"
+    return ranges
+
+
+def run_fontconfig(args, env):
+    result = subprocess.run(args, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+def face(args, env, font_path, pin):
+    rows = run_fontconfig(args, env).splitlines()
+    assert len(rows) == 4, "Incomplete Fontconfig face record"
+    assert Path(rows[0]).resolve() == font_path, "Fontconfig selected an unpinned fallback"
+    assert rows[1] == pin["family"], "Font family differs"
+    assert rows[2] == pin["postScriptName"], "PostScript face differs"
+    ranges = charset_ranges(rows[3])
+    missing = [f"U+{ord(char):04X}" for char in sorted(set(pin["requiredText"]))
+               if not any(low <= ord(char) <= high for low, high in ranges)]
+    assert not missing, "Missing required Chinese glyphs: " + ", ".join(missing)
+    return {"file": str(font_path), "family": rows[1], "postScriptName": rows[2],
+            "charsetRanges": ranges, "requiredText": pin["requiredText"]}
+
+
+def snapshot(root, base, env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes):
+    root, base = Path(root), Path(base)
+    font_path = root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"]
+    data = regular_bytes(font_path)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_bytes = regular_bytes(config_path)
+    cache = root / "cache"
+    assert cache.is_dir() and not cache.is_symlink() and os.access(cache, os.W_OK), "Private font cache is unavailable"
+    assert config_bytes == configuration(root, base, pin), "Job font configuration changed"
+    assert env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") == str(config_path), "Job font configuration is not active"
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/OFL.txt") == license_bytes
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").decode("utf-8") == pin["copyright"] + "\n"
+    inspected = face(["fc-query", "--format", FORMAT, str(font_path)], env, font_path, pin)
+    resolved = face(["fc-match", "--format", FORMAT, PROBE], env, font_path, pin)
+    assert inspected == resolved, "Resolved CJK face differs from the inspected pinned face"
+    return {"pinSha256": sha256(pin_bytes),
+            "font": {"file": str(font_path), "sha256": sha256(data), "bytes": len(data),
+                     "gitBlobSha": pin["gitBlobSha"], "licenseSha256": sha256(license_bytes)},
+            "fontconfig": {"file": str(config_path), "sha256": sha256(config_bytes),
+                           "baseFile": str(base), "baseSha256": sha256(regular_bytes(base)),
+                           "cacheDirectory": str(root / "cache")},
+            "resolvedFor": PROBE, "resolvedFace": resolved}
+
+
+def verify(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    receipt_path = Path(env["TERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT"])
+    receipt_bytes = regular_bytes(receipt_path)
+    receipt = json.loads(receipt_bytes)
+    assert receipt["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-setup.v1"
+    assert receipt["workflow"] == {
+        "repository": env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"), "run": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
+        "attempt": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"), "job": env.get("GITHUB_JOB")}, "Font receipt belongs to another job"
+    root = receipt_path.parent.resolve()
+    assert root.is_relative_to(Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve()), "Font receipt is outside this runner's temp root"
+    assert receipt_path.name == "receipt.json"
+    observed = snapshot(root, receipt["snapshot"]["fontconfig"]["baseFile"], env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes)
+    assert observed == receipt["snapshot"], "Prepared font environment changed"
+    return {"schema": "terminal.cjk-font-runtime.v1", "receiptSha256": sha256(receipt_bytes),
+            "workflow": receipt["workflow"], **observed}
+
+
+def install(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    temp_root = Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    env_file = Path(env["GITHUB_ENV"])
+    assert env_file.is_absolute() and not env_file.is_symlink() and env_file.is_file()
+    assert not any(char in str(temp_root) + str(env_file) for char in "\r\n")
+    base = Path(env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") or "/etc/fonts/fonts.conf").resolve(strict=True)
+    regular_bytes(base)
+    for command in ["fc-cache", "fc-query", "fc-match"]:
+        if not shutil.which(command, path=env.get("PATH")):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Required existing Fontconfig command is unavailable: {command}")
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="terminal-cjk-", dir=temp_root)).resolve()
+    (root / "fonts").mkdir(); (root / "cache").mkdir()
+    data = download_font(pin)
+    temporary = root / "font.download"
+    temporary.write_bytes(data)
+    temporary.replace(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    (root / "fonts/OFL.txt").write_bytes(license_bytes)
+    (root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").write_text(pin["copyright"] + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_path.write_bytes(configuration(root, base, pin))
+    scoped = {**env, "FONTCONFIG_FILE": str(config_path)}
+    run_fontconfig(["fc-cache", "--force", str(root / "fonts")], scoped)
+    observed = snapshot(root, base, scoped, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes)
+    receipt = {"schema": "terminal.cjk-font-setup.v1", "preparedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+               "workflow": {"repository": env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"), "run": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
+                            "attempt": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"), "job": env.get("GITHUB_JOB")},
+               "snapshot": observed}
+    receipt_path = root / "receipt.json"
+    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    scoped["TERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT"] = str(receipt_path)
+    verified = verify(scoped)
+    # Export only after bytes, license, config, resolver and coverage all pass.
+    with env_file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
+        output.write(f"FONTCONFIG_FILE={config_path}\nTERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT={receipt_path}\n")
+    return verified
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] not in ("--install", "--verify"):
+        raise SystemExit("Use --install or --verify")
+    try:
+        result = install() if sys.argv[1] == "--install" else verify()
+        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))
+    except Exception as error:
+        print(f"CJK font dependency verification failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        raise SystemExit(1) from error

+

+- Artifact `unit-evidence-43088893028-1`, ID `13890390476`; zip SHA-256 `c9877931c8fc22a7bd87e3bbf9e1e54ee7fa8be0e1586f17ff1109e9fc9fcf56`.

The prior selected active packet is retained under `historical-active-inbox/`.

SQL0050, Macro #9601/provider, model target/ACK/persistence, authenticated and production/release acceptance remain open. No merge or auto-merge is requested. +# Correct the drawing cache contract and obtain a current ticker packet
+
+The previous source candidate e368f26 completed the current-input capture and F11 entry steps. Its unit job 130420100557 in run 42989799627 passed 23,272 tests and failed two. The attached original failure excerpt shows an obsolete transitional-cache expectation and a ticker evidence lock still bound to the prior TerminalShell. The actual CI merge checkout was 09495282, with canonical parents 18fabe9d and e368f26. Event metadata and branch-head identities are not substituted for that checkout.
+
+## Drawing owner behavior
+
+The product already resets the previous owner's drawing store in useLayoutEffect and publishes its store ref synchronously. The test now first proves owner A has a ready cache, then requires the transient B/A observation to contain no A cache and remain disabled. It still checks B's own ready placeholder, actual requests, stale A rejection immunity, and current B rejection disabling. All six drawing readiness tests pass. Temporarily restoring only the passive-effect reset makes the selected case fail on hasCache=true; the original TerminalShell bytes were restored exactly. No product behavior was relaxed to satisfy an obsolete expectation.
+
+## Ticker capture and source binding
+
+The existing serial Playwright owner now records its actual checkout, before/after sources, previous packet and sibling packet inventories, ten EN/ZH crops across desktop/tablet/mobile and unavailable states, exact report rows, and settled lifecycle. The observer is the already-qualified #1403 implementation with only two nonexistent WatchlistDisplaySettings paths omitted from its source list. The sixteen retained source inputs include the actual shell, spec, helpers, observer, configuration and lockfile. Its 33 receipt tests pass. No layout lock or image has been restamped. A genuine natural CI capture must return before its ten images and EVIDENCE.yml can be imported.
+
+The workflow retains the same serial lane, port, one worker, zero retries, job budget and existing artifact uploader. The shard contract now classifies opt-in suites by an actual opt-in environment flag; an ordinary ticker recapture is not a feature flag. All 281 affected CI contracts pass, including the existing four opt-in suites and production selection. Changed JS/TS lint and observer syntax checks pass. Full strict TypeScript from e368 remains the accepted unchanged-product check; natural CI will validate this followup.
+
+Both new e2e/tools files participate in the existing recursive visual source snapshot. Therefore the older e368 PL6/VI operation cannot qualify the new candidate. The next natural run must capture and validate a complete successor under the unchanged producer, explicit records selector and consumers. Historical PL6/VI/Batch3 manifests and memberships remain byte-exact. The committed-lock planner remains unchanged and binding. Complete generated operation families stay under the incumbent Actions artifact owner, with exact qualification and retention metadata required before acceptance; a green job or hash-only record cannot replace missing payloads.
+
+SQL0050, coordinated Macro/provider behavior, ordinary-model target/ACK/persistence acceptance, the historical M2 cleanup EPERM boundary, and native merge/release controls remain open. This source repair neither applies a migration nor enrolls, merges, deploys or claims production acceptance.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Provide one pinned CJK fallback in a private CI job, then revalidate it.
+
+Browser/apt setup remains the existing workflow owner's responsibility. This
+helper never installs system packages, changes product CSS, or writes shared
+font directories. --verify performs no download or environment-file mutation.
+"""
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import urllib.request
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+if sys.flags.optimize:
+    raise RuntimeError("Optimized Python cannot run CJK dependency verification")
+
+REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+PIN_PATH = REPO / ".github/fonts/noto-cjk/pin.json"
+PROBE = "sans-serif:lang=zh-cn"
+FORMAT = "%{file}\n%{family[0]}\n%{postscriptname}\n%{charset}\n"
+
+
+def sha256(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def git_blob_sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def regular_bytes(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected a regular, non-symlink file: {path}")
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def load_pin():
+    raw = regular_bytes(PIN_PATH)
+    pin = json.loads(raw)
+    assert pin["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-pin.v1"
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", pin["commit"])
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", pin["sha256"])
+    assert 0 < pin["bytes"] <= 32 * 1024 * 1024
+    assert pin["fileName"] == Path(pin["fileName"]).name
+    assert pin["url"] == (
+        f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{pin['repository']}/{pin['commit']}/{pin['path']}"
+    )
+    license_bytes = regular_bytes(REPO / pin["license"]["path"])
+    assert len(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["bytes"]
+    assert git_blob_sha(license_bytes) == pin["license"]["gitBlobSha"]
+    return pin, raw, license_bytes
+
+
+def validate_font(data, pin):
+    assert len(data) == pin["bytes"], "Pinned font byte length differs"
+    assert sha256(data) == pin["sha256"], "Pinned font SHA-256 differs"
+    assert git_blob_sha(data) == pin["gitBlobSha"], "Pinned upstream Git blob differs"
+
+
+def download_font(pin):
+    request = urllib.request.Request(pin["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "Terminal-CI-font-dependency"})
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
+        data = response.read(pin["bytes"] + 1)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    return data
+
+
+def configuration(root, base, pin):
+    family = pin["family"]
+    document = ET.Element("fontconfig")
+    # Fontconfig writes its first accessible cache. Keep this before the base
+    # include so simultaneous ubuntu0 slots cannot share this job's cache.
+    ET.SubElement(document, "cachedir").text = str(root / "cache")
+    ET.SubElement(document, "include", {"ignore_missing": "no"}).text = str(base)
+    ET.SubElement(document, "dir").text = str(root / "fonts")
+    # A runner may already have another version of this family. Keep its files
+    # untouched, but select only our pinned face within this private config.
+    selection = ET.SubElement(document, "selectfont")
+    rejected = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "rejectfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(rejected, "patelt", {"name": "family"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = family
+    accepted = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(selection, "acceptfont"), "pattern")
+    property_ = ET.SubElement(accepted, "patelt", {"name": "file"})
+    ET.SubElement(property_, "string").text = str(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    # Keep the base's Latin environment; prefer the pinned native fallback only
+    # for Chinese generic sans requests. This does not inject a page stylesheet.
+    match = ET.SubElement(document, "match", {"target": "pattern"})
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "lang", "compare": "contains"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "zh"
+    test = ET.SubElement(match, "test", {"name": "family", "compare": "eq"})
+    ET.SubElement(test, "string").text = "sans-serif"
+    edit = ET.SubElement(match, "edit", {"name": "family", "mode": "prepend_first", "binding": "strong"})
+    ET.SubElement(edit, "string").text = family
+    return (b'<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">\n'
+            + ET.tostring(document, encoding="utf-8") + b"\n")
+
+
+def charset_ranges(value):
+    ranges = []
+    for token in value.split():
+        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+(?:-[0-9a-fA-F]+)?", token):
+            raise ValueError("Unrecognized Fontconfig charset")
+        parts = token.split("-")
+        low, high = int(parts[0], 16), int(parts[-1], 16)
+        assert 0 <= low <= high <= 0x10FFFF
+        ranges.append([low, high])
+    assert ranges, "Fontconfig returned no glyph coverage"
+    return ranges
+
+
+def run_fontconfig(args, env):
+    result = subprocess.run(args, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+def face(args, env, font_path, pin):
+    rows = run_fontconfig(args, env).splitlines()
+    assert len(rows) == 4, "Incomplete Fontconfig face record"
+    assert Path(rows[0]).resolve() == font_path, "Fontconfig selected an unpinned fallback"
+    assert rows[1] == pin["family"], "Font family differs"
+    assert rows[2] == pin["postScriptName"], "PostScript face differs"
+    ranges = charset_ranges(rows[3])
+    missing = [f"U+{ord(char):04X}" for char in sorted(set(pin["requiredText"]))
+               if not any(low <= ord(char) <= high for low, high in ranges)]
+    assert not missing, "Missing required Chinese glyphs: " + ", ".join(missing)
+    return {"file": str(font_path), "family": rows[1], "postScriptName": rows[2],
+            "charsetRanges": ranges, "requiredText": pin["requiredText"]}
+
+
+def snapshot(root, base, env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes):
+    root, base = Path(root), Path(base)
+    font_path = root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"]
+    data = regular_bytes(font_path)
+    validate_font(data, pin)
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_bytes = regular_bytes(config_path)
+    cache = root / "cache"
+    assert cache.is_dir() and not cache.is_symlink() and os.access(cache, os.W_OK), "Private font cache is unavailable"
+    assert config_bytes == configuration(root, base, pin), "Job font configuration changed"
+    assert env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") == str(config_path), "Job font configuration is not active"
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/OFL.txt") == license_bytes
+    assert regular_bytes(root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").decode("utf-8") == pin["copyright"] + "\n"
+    inspected = face(["fc-query", "--format", FORMAT, str(font_path)], env, font_path, pin)
+    resolved = face(["fc-match", "--format", FORMAT, PROBE], env, font_path, pin)
+    assert inspected == resolved, "Resolved CJK face differs from the inspected pinned face"
+    return {"pinSha256": sha256(pin_bytes),
+            "font": {"file": str(font_path), "sha256": sha256(data), "bytes": len(data),
+                     "gitBlobSha": pin["gitBlobSha"], "licenseSha256": sha256(license_bytes)},
+            "fontconfig": {"file": str(config_path), "sha256": sha256(config_bytes),
+                           "baseFile": str(base), "baseSha256": sha256(regular_bytes(base)),
+                           "cacheDirectory": str(root / "cache")},
+            "resolvedFor": PROBE, "resolvedFace": resolved}
+
+
+def verify(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    receipt_path = Path(env["TERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT"])
+    receipt_bytes = regular_bytes(receipt_path)
+    receipt = json.loads(receipt_bytes)
+    assert receipt["schema"] == "terminal.cjk-font-setup.v1"
+    assert receipt["workflow"] == {
+        "repository": env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"), "run": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
+        "attempt": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"), "job": env.get("GITHUB_JOB")}, "Font receipt belongs to another job"
+    root = receipt_path.parent.resolve()
+    assert root.is_relative_to(Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve()), "Font receipt is outside this runner's temp root"
+    assert receipt_path.name == "receipt.json"
+    observed = snapshot(root, receipt["snapshot"]["fontconfig"]["baseFile"], env, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes)
+    assert observed == receipt["snapshot"], "Prepared font environment changed"
+    return {"schema": "terminal.cjk-font-runtime.v1", "receiptSha256": sha256(receipt_bytes),
+            "workflow": receipt["workflow"], **observed}
+
+
+def install(env=None):
+    env = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
+    pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes = load_pin()
+    temp_root = Path(env["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    env_file = Path(env["GITHUB_ENV"])
+    assert env_file.is_absolute() and not env_file.is_symlink() and env_file.is_file()
+    assert not any(char in str(temp_root) + str(env_file) for char in "\r\n")
+    base = Path(env.get("FONTCONFIG_FILE") or "/etc/fonts/fonts.conf").resolve(strict=True)
+    regular_bytes(base)
+    for command in ["fc-cache", "fc-query", "fc-match"]:
+        if not shutil.which(command, path=env.get("PATH")):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Required existing Fontconfig command is unavailable: {command}")
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="terminal-cjk-", dir=temp_root)).resolve()
+    (root / "fonts").mkdir(); (root / "cache").mkdir()
+    data = download_font(pin)
+    temporary = root / "font.download"
+    temporary.write_bytes(data)
+    temporary.replace(root / "fonts" / pin["fileName"])
+    (root / "fonts/OFL.txt").write_bytes(license_bytes)
+    (root / "fonts/COPYRIGHT.txt").write_text(pin["copyright"] + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    config_path = root / "fonts.conf"
+    config_path.write_bytes(configuration(root, base, pin))
+    scoped = {**env, "FONTCONFIG_FILE": str(config_path)}
+    run_fontconfig(["fc-cache", "--force", str(root / "fonts")], scoped)
+    observed = snapshot(root, base, scoped, pin, pin_bytes, license_bytes)
+    receipt = {"schema": "terminal.cjk-font-setup.v1", "preparedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+               "workflow": {"repository": env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"), "run": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
+                            "attempt": env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"), "job": env.get("GITHUB_JOB")},
+               "snapshot": observed}
+    receipt_path = root / "receipt.json"
+    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    scoped["TERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT"] = str(receipt_path)
+    verified = verify(scoped)
+    # Export only after bytes, license, config, resolver and coverage all pass.
+    with env_file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
+        output.write(f"FONTCONFIG_FILE={config_path}\nTERMINAL_CJK_FONT_RECEIPT={receipt_path}\n")
+    return verified
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] not in ("--install", "--verify"):
+        raise SystemExit("Use --install or --verify")
+    try:
+        result = install() if sys.argv[1] == "--install" else verify()
+        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))
+    except Exception as error:
+        print(f"CJK font dependency verification failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        raise SystemExit(1) from error

+# PR #1048: original CI active-inbox packet import
+
+The published head `4ffab199156516d94a5a3a2d7e860fa342813eb2` carried a stale active-inbox driver binding. The unchanged strict reader reproduces that failure: recorded driver `856da74c...`, actual driver `8ccd2435...`. This repair imports the already-returned original CI artifact; it does not recapture or rewrite capture identity.
+
+## Exact source and artifact
+
+- Original workflow: https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/actions/runs/43088893028 (attempt 1).
+- Artifact `unit-evidence-43088893028-1`, ID `13890390476`; zip SHA-256 `c9877931c8fc22a7bd87e3bbf9e1e54ee7fa8be0e1586f17ff1109e9fc9fcf56`.
+- Actual producer checkout `0d86ec458ae5589a02257305842f37d5b8584d6c`, tree `01143905d2933d5d4504bb5060033db74f1fd14d`, captured `2026-11-11T19:41:37.944Z`. The immutable GitHub readback confirms parents `568fa505afb068900424fe4db0da67587d46a114` and `4ffab199156516d94a5a3a2d7e860fa342813eb2`.
+- Exact manifest SHA-256 `ccb6a5f19cb6498016ca986555488dc9a988896b5f3e6abcbd18fdab32013b04`. Raw checkout, producer proof and producer manifest are preserved under `original-ci-artifact/`.
+
+## Qualification
+
+The existing `readInboxPacket` rejects the prior selected packet, accepts the staged original artifact, and accepts the installed packet after the eight PNGs are copied and `capture.json` is copied last. All 15 source bindings, all eight full PNG decodes, exact image digests, crop geometry, versions and cleanup receipts pass. The existing `f11_7RecurringBriefsEvidence.test.ts` passes all six tests unchanged. All 13 historical mixed-packet files and the existing explicit scope file remain byte-identical.
